full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the instant civil petition for leave to appeal are that respondent No.1 as the pre-emptor instituted Miscellaneous Case No.7 of 2007 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Kumarkhali, Kushtia against the petitioner along with others for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The pre-emptor contended, inter alia, that the land measuring 0.16 acre of plot No.300 appertaining to RS Khatian No.11 under Mouza-Sultanpur belonged to Ayen Uddin, Koyaz Ali, Riaz Uddin and Torap Ali in equal share. The pre-emptor, predecessor of respondent Nos.2-7 purchased the land from Aynuddin and Koyaz Ali. After death of Riazuddin, the pre-emptor and respondent Nos.2-7 got the land as heirs and respondent Nos.8-16 got the land as heirs of Torap Ali, respondent Nos.1-8 sold out the land measuring 0.1484 acre in favour of respondent No.1 on 30-10-2006 by registered sale deed No.3531 without informing the pre-emptor. Respondent No.1 is a stranger purchaser. The pre-emptor is a co-sharer of the jama. So, the pre-emptor is entitled to get the said land by way of pre-emption, hence she filed the instant Case.
